beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: That door that swings outward when you push it. The sprinkler over your head. The fire drill you groan about every year. All three exist because of one Saturday afternoon in New York, in nineteen eleven.
beats.subtitle: That door that swings outward when you push it. The sprinkler over your head. The fire drill you groan about every year. All three exist because of one Saturday afternoon in New York, in nineteen eleven.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: It's March twenty-fifth, nineteen eleven. You're a young immigrant, and you sew blouses called shirtwaists on the ninth floor of the Asch Building.
beats.subtitle: It's March twenty-fifth, nineteen eleven. You're a young immigrant, and you sew blouses called shirtwaists on the ninth floor of the Asch Building.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: The Triangle Waist Company fills the top three floors: eight, nine and ten. About five hundred workers. Mostly young women and girls. Rows and rows of sewing machines.
beats.subtitle: The Triangle Waist Company fills the top three floors: eight, nine and ten. About five hundred workers. Mostly young women and girls. Rows and rows of sewing machines.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: It's Saturday, almost quitting time. And there's one house rule: the doors stay locked. The bosses say it stops stealing. And unplanned breaks.
beats.subtitle: It's Saturday, almost quitting time. And there's one house rule: the doors stay locked. The bosses say it stops stealing. And unplanned breaks.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Downstairs, on eight, someone drops a match or a cigarette into a bin of fabric scraps.
beats.subtitle: Downstairs, on eight, someone drops a match or a cigarette into a bin of fabric scraps.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Within five minutes, the whole eighth floor is on fire.
beats.subtitle: Within five minutes, the whole eighth floor is on fire.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Up on ten, they get a warning. They run for the roof, and students from the university next door push ladders across to them. Almost everyone on ten gets out.
beats.subtitle: Up on ten, they get a warning. They run for the roof, and students from the university next door push ladders across to them. Almost everyone on ten gets out.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: On nine, you look up from your machine, and there's fire in the windows.
beats.subtitle: On nine, you look up from your machine, and there's fire in the windows.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: OK. Exits. You've got options.
beats.subtitle: OK. Exits. You've got options.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Option one: the stairs to Washington Place. Locked.
beats.subtitle: Option one: the stairs to Washington Place. Locked.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Option two: the other stairs. The fire is already coming up them.
beats.subtitle: Option two: the other stairs. The fire is already coming up them.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Option three: the elevators. The operators make trip after trip, until they can't anymore.
beats.subtitle: Option three: the elevators. The operators make trip after trip, until they can't anymore.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Option four: the fire escape. It twists, and collapses.
beats.subtitle: Option four: the fire escape. It twists, and collapses.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Option five: the fire department! They arrive fast. Big ladders. Big hoses.
beats.subtitle: Option five: the fire department! They arrive fast. Big ladders. Big hoses.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: The ladders stop floors below you. The water can't reach either.
beats.subtitle: The ladders stop floors below you. The water can't reach either.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: Some people make the last choice there is. They jump.
beats.subtitle: Some people make the last choice there is. They jump.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: One hundred forty-six people die. Most of them young women. The youngest were fourteen.
beats.subtitle: One hundred forty-six people die. Most of them young women. The youngest were fourteen.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Now here's the part that should make you angry. New York's law already said factory doors must not be locked during working hours. The rule existed. Nobody checked.
beats.subtitle: Now here's the part that should make you angry. New York's law already said factory doors must not be locked during working hours. The rule existed. Nobody checked.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: The owners were tried for manslaughter. Not guilty. Later they settled the lawsuits: seventy-five dollars per life.
beats.subtitle: The owners were tried for manslaughter. Not guilty. Later they settled the lawsuits: seventy-five dollars per life.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: But New York didn't let it go. A young woman named Frances Perkins watched the fire from the street.
beats.subtitle: But New York didn't let it go. A young woman named Frances Perkins watched the fire from the street.

beats.speaker: vo
beats.say: She joined a new Factory Investigating Commission. Inspectors walked into factory after factory, and the state passed more than twenty new laws.
beats.subtitle: She joined a new Factory Investigating Commission. Inspectors walked into factory after factory, and the state passed more than twenty new laws.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Doors that open outward, and stay unlocked while you work. Automatic sprinklers in tall factories. Fire drills. Fire alarms. And New York City set up a Bureau of Fire Prevention.
beats.subtitle: Doors that open outward, and stay unlocked while you work. Automatic sprinklers in tall factories. Fire drills. Fire alarms. And New York City set up a Bureau of Fire Prevention.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Perkins later became the first woman in a U.S. president's cabinet.
beats.subtitle: Perkins later became the first woman in a U.S. president's cabinet.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Look at it rule by rule. Every one of them fixes a way out that failed on the ninth floor.
beats.subtitle: Look at it rule by rule. Every one of them fixes a way out that failed on the ninth floor.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: A locked door?
beats.subtitle: A locked door?

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Now it's illegal, and someone actually comes to check.
beats.subtitle: Now it's illegal, and someone actually comes to check.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: A door that opens the wrong way, against a crowd pushing to get out?
beats.subtitle: A door that opens the wrong way, against a crowd pushing to get out?

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Now it swings outward.
beats.subtitle: Now it swings outward.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Ladders that can't reach?
beats.subtitle: Ladders that can't reach?

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Sprinklers fight the fire from the inside, before it grows.
beats.subtitle: Sprinklers fight the fire from the inside, before it grows.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Nobody knows where to go?
beats.subtitle: Nobody knows where to go?

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: Fire drills. You practise until your feet know the way.
beats.subtitle: Fire drills. You practise until your feet know the way.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: And the alarm? It rings on every floor, not just one.
beats.subtitle: And the alarm? It rings on every floor, not just one.

beats.speaker: inspector
beats.say: So next time a fire drill ruins your afternoon, remember the ninth floor. And that's why, today, exit doors swing outward, stay unlocked, and lead somewhere safe.
beats.subtitle: So next time a fire drill ruins your afternoon, remember the ninth floor. And that's why, today, exit doors swing outward, stay unlocked, and lead somewhere safe.
